note: M-values on the same 8192-locus prefix as the neural bake-off. This is all ATS samples, not a sample subset. Penalised linear models use SGD with L2 or elastic-net penalties (coordinate-descent ElasticNet / SAGA logistic did not finish on 8192 loci).
